newsitem.title: USA: Security starts social awareness fund.
newsitem.headline: Security starts social awareness fund.

text.p: Security Benefit Group of Cos said it started the Security Social Awareness Fund to invest in "companies that exhibit social responsibility, as well as financial integrity."

The fund will seek companies that contribute "substantially" to communities where they operate, maintain "positive" record on employment relations, "show progress" in the promotion of women and minorities, have policies that "support" working parents, and "address environmental challenges."

The fund will not invest in companies that have "substantial, unresolved environmental remediation liabilities," get "significant" revenues from contracting for nuclear or conventional weapons, have an ownership interest in nuclear power plants, or design or sell nuclear reactors, produce or distribute alcohol, tobacco, or are in the gaming industry.
